# Synthetic acceptance audio

`chinese.wav` is synthetic speech generated for this project's Windows acceptance test. It contains no recorded microphone audio or user conversation.

Text: 请检查订单和工单。左边放表格，右边放交期甘特图。先完成测试，不要直接发布。

PCM: 16 kHz, 16-bit, mono. Generated with the local macOS Tingting voice. Used only as a deterministic smoke-test input; it does not establish real microphone accuracy.
